---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Propose a new capability, CLI command, or enhancement to Engineering OS
title: '[FEAT]: '
labels: ['enhancement', 'spec-needed']
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]")

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How should this new capability behave?

## 👥 Target Users & Personas
- **Who needs this?** (e.g. Lead Software Architect, DevOps / SRE, AI Coding Agent, Contributor)
- **Why is this valuable?**

## 📐 Requirements & Acceptance Criteria
Please sketch out tentative requirements using the SDD format:
- **REQ-001**: Given [context], When [action], Then [outcome]
- **REQ-002**: ...

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🛡️ Affected Quality Gates
Which of the 15 Quality Gates will enforce or evaluate this feature?
- [ ] Product / Spec Gate
- [ ] UX Gate
- [ ] Architecture / ADR Gate
- [ ] Contract Gate
- [ ] Security Gate
- [ ] AI Evaluation Gate
- [ ] Operations Gate
